notes: The Mission on the 1980 map, sheet p14 (page as scanned: the north-south streets run across the page). Printed names in the box: SAN JOSE AVE., VALENCIA, BARTLETT, MISSION ST., SHOTWELL, and '...ADO' on a short street above San Jose at x 2275-2295; block numbers 6514-6519, 6526-6532, 6568-6575, 5501, 3635, 3642-3644. Box as assigned (1480, 2670, 900, 640), not moved. Every printed block is a polygon (42 blocks, 43 polygons: block 6532 is two, see 2); everything else is street. No open polygons: the box holds no ground without an outline of its own. How the sides were placed: each block's paper was taken from the scan (ink darker than 138; the 4-connected paper pieces inside each block picked by hand, letter holes filled), its convex outline found (traced outline after a 13 px closing for the two non-convex blocks, 6571 at x 1541-1625 y 3015-3198 and the block at x 1537-1627 y 3221-3300), and each side pushed out to the centre of the outermost ink px of the block's own thin line, measured along that side (thin lines 2.5-3.75 px, median push 3.0 px; 3.0 px where letters or a heavy line touch the side); small corner cuts were squared where the scan's corner is solid ink, printed rounded corners kept (e.g. 6568 at (1558-1572, 2775-2783)). Then checked block by block on 4x-8x ruled close-ups and the labels picture, and every side measured against the scan: median 0.1 px, 90% within 0.6 px of the outer edge of the block's thin line. Set by hand after measuring: the bottom-right corner of block 6516 (1998, 2985), where the letter P of a small P district cuts the paper; the top-right corner of the block at (2205-2371, 3108-3193), where the C-2 letters cover it; the right side of the block at (2016-2094, 2670-2701) moved out 1 px; the top of the block at (2016-2184, 2902-2984) straightened at y 2902 (a heavy border runs 5 px above it); bottoms at y 2985 and 2983 and a top at y 3216-3217 moved 1 px; the two slivers at the bottom typed by hand. Heavy zoning borders: here they run in the streets a px or two clear of the block lines (all street), and through blocks along rear lot lines (rows at about y 2750, 2848, 2948, 3053, 3152, 3258) and round small districts inside blocks; one polygon per block whatever crosses it. Small district boxes straddle block corners at (1970-2010, 2840-2895), (1970-2011, 2952-3002), (2005-2050, 2994-3036), (1970-2010, 3050-3100), (1695-1752, 2945-3002): the block's corner is on its own thin lines inside them, the parts in the street are street. Lettering in streets and over block lines (C-2, RH-3, RM-1, M-2, the '3' at (1810-1825, 3060-3092)) is ignored. Judgment calls (please rule): 1. The strip x 2095-2117, y 2721-2774 between two heavy borders, closed top and bottom by the thin lines of the block round it and carrying the number 3644, is kept in that block (x 2017-2182, y 2714-2779) as one block. It lines up with the street x 2096-2109 north of San Jose; if it is a path or street, it should be cut out. 2. Block 6532 (x 1640-1807, top of box to y 2699) has a dead-end alley with paper between its lines (x 1757-1761) from San Jose north to y 2640, outside the box: cut out as street, so inside the box the block is two polygons, (1640-1756) and (1762-1807). 3. One block each, with a heavy border through them and no street paper: x 1826-1995 above San Jose (borders at x 1873 and 1938) and x 2202-2275 above San Jose (border at x 2238-2242, which carries on across the street). 4. The narrow slanted street between 6570 and 6571 (about 4-6 px of paper, from (1548, 3015) to (1600, 3110)) is street. 5. At the bottom-left the box catches the tops of two blocks below the street, x 1480-1503 and x 1533-1586, y 3302-3309: typed as blocks. The heavy box in Shotwell at (2245-2340, 3298-3310) and the heavy dip at (2110-2145, 3295-3302) are in the street. Blocks cut by the box's sides end on the box edge.
